summary: This resolution elects Ms. Ansari to the House Committee on Education and Workforce, Mr. Green of Texas to the Committee on Homeland Security, Ms. Lee of Nevada to the Committee on Natural Resources, and Mr. Foster to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.

scores.thoughts: This resolution only appoints members to House committees and contains no provisions related to budgets, appropriations, or spending levels. It has no bearing on government spending.
The bill is a procedural committee assignment resolution with no tax-related content or implications.
No healthcare policy, funding, or regulatory language appears in the resolution.
The text does not address firearms, regulations, or rights in any way.
No immigration, border, or visa provisions are present.
The resolution contains nothing related to reproductive rights or abortion access.
No military, defense, or national security funding or policy changes are involved.
Although one appointee is assigned to the Natural Resources Committee, the resolution itself makes no environmental policy changes or regulatory adjustments.
No welfare, entitlement, or social program provisions exist in the bill.
One member is assigned to the Education and Workforce Committee, but the resolution does not alter education policy, funding, or structure.
The bill has no content related to drug enforcement, decriminalization, or substance regulation.
No criminal justice, sentencing, or policing measures are addressed.
The resolution contains no trade, tariff, or globalization provisions.
No fiscal policy, deficit, or debt-related language is present.
The bill does not engage with LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
No foreign aid, international assistance, or diplomacy provisions appear.
The resolution is unrelated to voting access, election integrity, or electoral procedures.
Although one appointee goes to the Science Committee, the bill itself makes no changes to technology regulation or privacy rules.
Assignment to the Education and Workforce Committee occurs, but the resolution does not modify labor law, union rights, or worker protections.
No provisions address religious exemptions, civil rights, or anti-discrimination policy.
